topic: Analytics access and company data issues
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on user permissions within the staging analytics environment. It was noted that one participant ([p1]) shared links to the staging analytics platform, detailing specific viewing capabilities for different users (e.g., 'emma' can see everyone; 'juho' can only see JCD). A key issue raised was why Bauer Media Outdoor Suomi Oy lacked a shared company ID (7962) in the listed companies, and it was noted that another user ('ilpo') could only view data for Bauer Media Outdoor Suomi Oy.
action_items: Investigate why Bauer Media Outdoor Suomi Oy is missing shared company ID 7962 from the list of companies in the staging analytics environment.
